import sys, json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def num(x, nd=2):
    return float(np.round(float(x), nd))

df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])

facts = []

# ---- TOTALS ----
tot_rev_tw = df['Revenue_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_rev_lw = df['Revenue_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_rev_ly = df['Revenue_LY'].sum(skipna=True) if df['Revenue_LY'].notna().any() else np.nan
tot_units_tw = df['Units_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_units_lw = df['Units_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_orders_tw = df['Orders_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_orders_lw = df['Orders_LW'].sum(skipna=True)

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"TW","value":num(tot_rev_tw),
              "formula":"sum(Revenue_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LW","value":num(tot_rev_lw),
              "formula":"sum(Revenue_LW)"})
if not np.isnan(tot_rev_ly):
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LY","value":num(tot_rev_ly),
                  "formula":"sum(Revenue_LY)"})

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"TW","value":num(tot_units_tw,0),
              "formula":"sum(Units_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"TW","value":num(tot_orders_tw,0),
              "formula":"sum(Orders_TW)"})

if tot_rev_lw and not np.isnan(tot_rev_lw) and tot_rev_lw != 0:
    wow_total = (tot_rev_tw - tot_rev_lw) / tot_rev_lw * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":num(wow_total,1),
                  "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100"})

if not np.isnan(tot_rev_ly) and tot_rev_ly != 0:
    yoy_total = (tot_rev_tw - tot_rev_ly) / tot_rev_ly * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":num(yoy_total,1),
                  "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100"})

# ---- TOP ENTITIES BY REVENUE TW ----
top_rev = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False).head(5)
for _, row in top_rev.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue", "period":"TW",
                  "value": num(row['Revenue_TW']),
                  "formula":"Revenue_TW"})

# ---- TOP WoW GAINERS / DECLINERS ----
wow_df = df.dropna(subset=['WoW_Pct']).sort_values('WoW_Pct', ascending=False)
for _, row in wow_df.head(3).iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue", "period":"WoW",
                  "value": num(row['WoW_Pct'],1),
                  "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})
for _, row in wow_df.tail(3).iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue", "period":"WoW",
                  "value": num(row['WoW_Pct'],1),
                  "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})

# ---- TOP YoY GAINERS / DECLINERS ----
yoy_df = df.dropna(subset=['YoY_Pct']).sort_values('YoY_Pct', ascending=False)
for _, row in yoy_df.head(2).iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue", "period":"YoY",
                  "value": num(row['YoY_Pct'],1),
                  "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})
for _, row in yoy_df.tail(2).iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue", "period":"YoY",
                  "value": num(row['YoY_Pct'],1),
                  "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})

# ---- SHARE LEADERS ----
share_df = df.dropna(subset=['Share_Pct']).sort_values('Share_Pct', ascending=False).head(3)
for _, row in share_df.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"share", "period":"TW",
                  "value": num(row['Share_Pct'],1),
                  "formula":"Share_Pct"})

# ---- RANK 1 ENTITY ----
rank1 = df[df['Rank'] == 1]
for _, row in rank1.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"rank", "period":"TW",
                  "value": num(row['Rank'],0),
                  "formula":"Rank"})

# Trim to 25 facts max
facts = facts[:25]

print(json.dumps(facts))
